description: Reconstruction of front boundary wall; lowering and re-modelling of front lightwells and steps; alterations to fenestration. Erection of a single storey rear infill extension. Internal alterations including reconstruction of lower ground floor and subfloor and replacement floor finishes and partitions. Installation of air source pumps and air conditioning condenser in rear garden. Erection of pavilion in front garden. Landscaping in front and rear gardens. Installation of solar panels on roof.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage statement, Planning statement, Fire strategy, door schedule, solar PV specification, Archaeological Desk Based assessment, Site Investigation Report, Construction Method Statement, Plant Noise Impact Assessment, Window Schedule, Tree Survey, Flood Risk Assessment, Sustainable Drainage Assessment, Light assessment correspondence, Addendum to FRA report, LANDVAC window specification, [Drawing Numbers] GIH-00-A, GIH-01-A, GIH-02-A, GIH-03-A, GIH-04-A, GIH-05-A, GIH-06-A, GIH-07-A, GIH-08-A, GIH-09-A, GIH-10-A, GIH-11-A, GIH-12-A, GIH-13-A, GIH-14-A, GIH-200-A, GIH-201-A, GIH-202-A, GIH-203-A, GIH-204-A, GIH-205-A, GIH-206-A, GIH-207-A, GIH-208-A, GIH-209-A, GIH-210-A, GIH-211-A, GIH-212-A, GIH-213-A, GIH-300-A, GIH-320-A, GIH-321-A, GIH-325-A, GIH-326-A, GIH-327-A, LBS-600-A, LBS-601-A, LBS-602-A, LBS-603-A, LBS-604-A, LBS-605-A, LBS-606-A, LBS-607-A, LBS-608-A, LBS-609-A, LBS-610-A, LBS-611-A, LBS-612-A, LBS-613-A, GIH-620-A, GIH-621-A, GIH-622-A, GIH-623-A, GIH-624-A, GIH-625-A, GIH-626-A, GIH-627-A, GIH-628-A, GIH-629-A, GIH-630-A, GIH-631-A, GIH-632-A, GIH-633-A, Received: 03/09/2021; Design & Access statement Received: 15/09/2021; [Drawing Numbers] GIH-99-B, GIH-100-A, GIH-101-B, GIH-102-B, GIH-103-B, GIH-104-B, GIH-105-A, GIH-106-A, GIH-107-A, GIH-108-B, GIH-109-B,GIH-110-A, GIH-111-A, GIH-112-A, GIH-170-B & GIH-700-A Received: 28/10/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Mechanical Services Noise Control 

a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved. 
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter. 
c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.

Condition : 6 - Archaeology 

No demolition or development shall take place until a written scheme of
investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the local
planning authority in writing. For land that is included within the WSI, no
demolition or development shall take place other than in accordance with
the agreed WSI, which shall include the statement of significance and
research objectives, and
A. The programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of  a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works
B. Where appropriate, details of a programme for delivering related positive public benefits
C. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent
analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of resulting material.
This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the WSI

Condition : 7 - The new windows formed in the side elevation of the rear central outrigger shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
